counterfactual_missing_items: SARS-CoV-2 antigen test positive (>5000 pg/mL) from oropharyngeal swab
decisive_items: Histology showed diffuse contraction band necrosis with several lymphocytes in cardiac muscle
Elevated cardiac markers (troponin and brain natriuretic peptide)
response.rationale: R4 provides direct cardiac pathology and markers consistent with myocarditis, while R2 only supplies COVID-19 and cytokine evidence without cardiac findings. R4 is more complete on anatomy and mechanism, though it lacks the viral cause; R2 has the cause but misses the cardiac evidence.

rejected.why: Contradicted by absence of coronary artery disease
Thrombotic microangiopathy is not supported by the cardiac inflammation findings
ARDS does not explain the cardiac findings
